epics.title: Local Docker Compose Deployment
epics.jtbd: When a system operator wants to verify the application, I want to launch the full stack via a docker-compose file that exposes a health-check endpoint, so that I can observe the real running product instead of relying solely on passing builds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual environment setup and verification time from >15 minutes to <2 minutes
epics.tocConstraintRef: Environment provisioning and runtime verification bottleneck
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root that starts the full stack.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint to verify the running stack.

slices.title: Add root docker-compose.yml and health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the docker orchestration for this epic, I want to create a docker-compose.yml that wires all necessary services together, so that the entire stack starts deterministically and its health can be verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local checkout of the repository
When I run docker-compose up at the root
Then all required backend, frontend, and database services start successfully
Given the services are running
When I make an HTTP request to the health-check endpoint
Then it returns a 200 OK status to confirm the stack is operational
slices.tocConstraintRef: Local stack startup and validation cycle
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce container start failure rate to 0% and time-to-health-check to <60 seconds
